_readme: The recurring cast for the Ribbit Reading App, confirmed with Kyle 2026-08-12.
Six diverse children, each with a locked physical description. Assign 1-2 per
sub-level (mirroring the Beginner 4 / Mika pattern) so each batch has a
consistent, recognizable protagonist, and rotate through the roster across
sub-levels so a reader who progresses through the app starts recognizing faces.
When writing a story's character-guides.json entry, copy a character's
'description' field VERBATIM — identical wording across every story they
appear in is what holds the look together across independent generation calls.
Clothing is deliberately left out of the locked description (unlike Mika, who
wore one outfit across one continuous day) so it can vary sensibly per story
(school uniform, swimwear, winter coat) while face and hair stay the anchor.
Assignment log — which character(s) covered which sub-level:

Amara.description: Round face, warm dark brown skin, big expressive brown eyes, a wide smile with a visible gap between her front teeth. Hair worn in two puffy afro bunches, each with a colourful bobble.

Kenji.description: Round face, light tan skin, short tousled black hair, small round glasses, a gentle easy smile.

Priya.description: Warm brown skin, long dark hair worn in a single thick braid over one shoulder, bright dark eyes, a wide cheerful smile.

Tom.description: Fair skin with light freckles across his nose and cheeks, sandy-blonde messy hair, a big gap-toothed grin.

Mei.description: Pale skin, straight black hair in a neat bob with a blue ribbon clip, round cheeks, a soft smile.

Ollie.description: Light-brown skin, curly brown hair, a gap-toothed grin, light freckles across his nose.
